name: claude-code-service
description: Claude Code CLI service — WebSocket PTY with Redis heartbeat registration for AI agent terminal access

injected_env_vars.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
injected_env_vars.description: Anthropic API key for Claude Code CLI. Obrigatória — sem ela o Claude Code não funciona.

injected_env_vars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
injected_env_vars.description: Model mapping for Haiku tier. Default: deepseek-v4-flash

injected_env_vars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
injected_env_vars.description: Model mapping for Sonnet tier. Default: deepseek-v4-flash

injected_env_vars.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
injected_env_vars.description: Model mapping for Opus tier. Default: deepseek-v4-pro
